title: Tensor coherence of the specified action-site comparisons
statement: Given a twisted action-site Presentation P [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data], let U be P.modules.functor followed by forgetPairs(sigma). The specified P.tensor components form a natural isomorphism tau from the source sheaf tensor followed by U to U times U followed by the target sheaf tensor. There is a TensorCoherence structure [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data] on tau for the existing symmetric monoidal structures of sheaves of modules. The forward component of tau at every (M,N) is exactly P.tensor(M,N).hom. The construction uses P.unit and proves associativity and both unit equations from the pure-tensor restriction formulas; it uses P.symmetry for symmetry. No internal-Hom comparison or evaluation-preservation assertion is included.

proof.text: For the left unitor precompose by P.tensor.inv and postcompose by restriction. The lax monoidal forgetful functor obtained from the sheafification adjunction supplies its pure-tensor formula. P.tensor_pure and P.unit_sections identify the two scalar multiplications; linearity of restriction and the inverse identities of coefficientRestriction prove equality. Derive the right-unit law from this left-unit law using braiding naturality and P.symmetry. P.symmetry also gives the symmetry field directly.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_coherence (P : Presentation J s R a) :
    letI := P.category
    let U := P.modules.functor ⋙ forgetPairs (sigma J s R a)
    ∃ τ : @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory P.coefficient) ⋙ U ≅
        (U.prod U) ⋙ @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R),
      Nonempty (RingedForgetTensorTransposition.TensorCoherence
        (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory P.coefficient) (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R)
        (SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory P.coefficient) (SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory R)
        U τ) ∧ ∀ M N : Modules P.coefficient,
          τ.hom.app (M, N) = (P.tensor M N).hom
